why_tagline: MORE THAN A FRANCHISE. A LEGACY.
why_p1: Starting a food business from scratch means building everything from the ground up — brand identity, customer trust, menu positioning and operating systems.
why_p2: A GPO franchise gives entrepreneurs the opportunity to build around an established brand concept with a legacy dating back to 1976.
usp_sub: Comprehensive ecosystem designed for partner operational excellence.

usp_items.title: ESTABLISHED BRAND
usp_items.desc: GPO Ke Thandey Dahi Bade has been associated with Lucknow’s food culture since 1976.

usp_items.title: BRANDING SUPPORT
usp_items.desc: Marketing and branding support is included as part of the franchise offering.

usp_items.title: TRADEMARK / BRAND RIGHTS
usp_items.desc: Franchise partners receive rights to use the GPO brand as defined by the franchise agreement.

usp_items.title: STORE OPERATIONS SUPPORT
usp_items.desc: A trained store operations staff member is provided at the start to support the initial store setup and operations.

usp_items.title: TECHNOLOGY SUPPORT
usp_items.desc: Access to modern order-management tools, including WhatsApp-based ordering and live tracking capabilities.

usp_items.title: FOCUSED FOOD FORMAT
usp_items.desc: A simple and recognisable product proposition built around Dahi Bade and complementary Indian snacks.
